name: agent-skill-ultimate-coding
description: Understand, design, build, verify and report like a careful senior engineer: must-follow safety rules, task sizing, and proof before calling work done.

progressTracker.title: Progress tracker
progressTracker.description: The bar above the prompt: working, subagent working, stopped, waiting for you or done, with the task size, checks and confidence.

scorecard.title: Session scorecard (/uc-score)
scorecard.description: A /uc-score panel summing up the session: tasks by size, confidence, cards, edits, checks and check-diff results.

checkDiffLine.title: check-diff line under edits
checkDiffLine.description: Show check-diff's verdict under each file edit. Claude still gets the findings either way.

designCardGate.title: Design-card gate
designCardGate.description: Edits that touch money, access, personal data, migrations, concurrency or a public API wait for a design card covering them (adds the design_card tool).

reportCheck.title: Report check
reportCheck.description: After a turn that changed code, if Claude stops without the skill's report and Confidence line, it is asked once to add them. Skipped when the project's own CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md sets its own report format.
